summary: Established OncoReady's premier light-theme clinical design system and interactive Treatment Readiness Graph architecture. The visual language conveys calm clinical precision and empathetic clarity across five responsive surfaces: Patient Treatment Home, Guided Readiness Check, Staff Exception Queue, Maria Case Workspace with Live Readiness Graph, and Permission-Filtered Caregiver Resolution View.

visual_direction.layout: Airy, luminous layout with high-contrast surfaces (slate-50 background, white elevated cards, 1px precision slate-200 borders). Clean two-column workspace on desktop (320px queue rail, flexible graph canvas, 380px action/timeline drawer) and a focused, comfortable single-column mobile view (max-width 480px) optimized for high-anxiety patient interactions.
visual_direction.color: High-clarity clinical light palette (WCAG AAA/AA+ compliant): Slate-50 app canvas (#F8FAFC), crisp white card surfaces (#FFFFFF), deep slate-900 primary typography (#0F172A), brand indigo-600 (#4F46E5), medical sky-600 (#0284C7), semantic amber-500 (#F59E0B) for active blockers, emerald-600 (#059669) for confirmed readiness, and rose-600 (#E11D48) for critical alerts. Zero dark-mode or generic AI dashboard styling.
visual_direction.typography: Inter font family with strict typographic hierarchy: 32px display for the infusion proximity countdown, 24px h1 for primary view titles, 20px h2 for section/card headings, 14px body with 1.5 line height for high legibility, 12px uppercase medium caption pills for status indicators, and JetBrains Mono with tabular figures enabled (tabular-nums) for case IDs, FHIR codes, and real-time timers.
visual_direction.spacing_and_shape: Strict 4px grid rhythm (4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48px). Refined smooth border radii (rounded-xl 16px for primary containers, rounded-lg 12px for interactive nodes/inputs, rounded-full for status pills). Soft slate-tinted layered shadows (shadow-sm, shadow-md, shadow-lg) providing physical depth without visual clutter.
visual_direction.component_presentation: Key signature components: (1) Hero Treatment Card with live countdown proximity timer and high-visibility CTA; (2) Treatment Readiness Graph featuring a central infusion target node connected via animated SVG bezier curves to clinical symptom clearance and transportation fulfillment nodes; (3) Deterministic Dual-Task Split Card showcasing verbatim clinical text in a high-contrast quote well with explicit non-AI triage badge; (4) Staff Exception Queue with SLA indicators; (5) Caregiver Permission-Filtered Card strictly excluding clinical data; (6) Append-Only Audit Event Timeline with causal state diffs.

motion.strategy: Fluid, purposeful motion using natural spring physics (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) that enhances comprehension and guides attention during critical state transitions (such as Maria's single report visibly splitting into two distinct owned workflows).
motion.transitions: 250ms slide-and-fade for view changes, 400ms organic SVG bezier path morphing and emerald glow burst when blockers are resolved, and 200ms smooth accordion expansions for task action panels.
motion.microinteractions: Subtle 100ms active scale-down (scale(0.98)) on button presses, smooth ring focus expansion, 2s gentle ambient pulse on active amber blocker nodes, and instant status pill badge flips.
motion.reduced_motion: Complete fallback for prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. All transforms, slide animations, and continuous pulses are replaced with instant or 100ms pure opacity changes, while state meaning is 100% preserved through text labels, distinct icons, and crisp border colors.

responsive.strategy: Mobile-first patient experience combined with adaptive high-density desktop clinical workbench.
responsive.notes: Patient treatment home and readiness check are optimized for 360px-480px touchscreens with sticky primary CTAs and min-44px touch targets. Staff workspace seamlessly reflows from a horizontal multi-column layout on >=1024px to a stacked drawer workflow on smaller screens.

application_states: Initial Opening State: Maria scheduled for tomorrow FOLFOX6 Cycle 4, readiness status: ACTION_REQUIRED
Readiness Check Active: Step-by-step validation with real-time field error messaging
Dual-Task Split: Deterministic generation of Nurse Clinical Review task and Navigator Transportation task
Staff Triage & Action: Live graph nodes pulsing amber -> staff acknowledgment/confirmation actions -> emerald resolution glow
Caregiver Update: Ana's permission-filtered view displaying confirmed ride details without clinical symptom exposure
Patient Confirmation: Maria acknowledges updated plan, overall state advances to PLAN_CONFIRMED
Deterministic Reset: 0ms instantaneous restoration of opening state from any screen
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA compliance with minimum 4.5:1 text contrast on all surfaces
Non-color state cues: Every status combines distinct SVG icons (triangle, check, clock), semantic color, and plain English text badges
Complete keyboard navigability with visible 2px indigo focus rings (ring-2 ring-indigo-500 ring-offset-2)
ARIA live regions (aria-live='polite') for asynchronous state transitions and countdown updates
assets_or_dependencies: Lucide React for clean, clinical-grade icons (ShieldAlert, Clock, CheckCircle2, Car, Stethoscope, ArrowRight, RotateCcw, AlertTriangle)
Tailwind CSS for tokenized utility styling and custom bezier transition classes
Canvas-confetti / lightweight micro-particle emitter for patient plan-confirmed closure celebration (optional/lightweight)
design_system_changes: Established initial design system in docs/design/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md defining light clinical palette, typography, grid, graph component specs, and motion tokens
notes_for_codex: The design is 100% light-theme with high clinical clarity, eliminating AI slop while providing advanced, smooth microinteractions.
The Treatment Readiness Graph visually connects the upcoming infusion to both blockers and updates dynamically upon staff and patient actions.
Caregiver data minimization is strictly enforced in the UI projection to protect patient clinical confidentiality.
Ready for Codex compatibility review and canonical SHA256 digest binding.
